mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_message(fault_id,device_id,device_name,owner_id,plot_id,plot_name,title,content,level) SELECT f.id,d.id,d.name,d.user_id,d.plot_id,p.plot_name,LEFT(CONCAT('设备维护：',f.fault_name),100), CONCAT(p.plot_name,'的',d.name,'发生故障，请技术人员或农场主及时处理'), CASE WHEN f.severity >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN f.severity = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END FROM iot_device_fault f JOIN iot_device d ON d.id=f.device_id JOIN plot p ON p.id=d.plot_id WHERE f.id=#{faultId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fault_id=VALUES(fault_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM maintenance_message WHERE fault_id=#{faultId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification(user_id,title,content,notice_type,ref_type,ref_id,maintenance_message_id,level,publisher_id,publisher_name,send_time,is_read,status) SELECT u.id,m.title,m.content,3,'maintenance_message',m.id,m.id,m.level,m.publisher_id,m.publisher_name,m.send_time,0,1 FROM maintenance_message m JOIN `user` u ON u.status=1 JOIN role r ON r.id=u.role_id WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.status=1 AND ( (u.id=m.owner_id AND LOWER(r.role_code)='farm_owner') OR (LOWER(r.role_code)='technician' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM farm_owner_technician b WHERE b.owner_user_id=m.owner_id AND b.technician_user_id=u.id AND b.status=1))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.notice_type=3 AND n.ref_type='maintenance_message' AND n.ref_id=m.id AND n.user_id=u.id)
mapper.sql:

m.status=1 AND n.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id,m.fault_id,m.device_id,m.device_name,m.version,m.publisher_id,m.plot_id,m.plot_name,m.title,m.content,m.level,m.publisher_name,m.send_time, COUNT(n.id) recipient_count,COALESCE(SUM(n.is_read=1),0) read_count FROM maintenance_message m LEFT JOIN notification n ON n.ref_id=m.id AND n.ref_type='maintenance_message' AND n.notice_type=3 AND n.status=1
m.status=1 AND n.user_id=#{userId} AND m.id=#{id} AND m.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND m.content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{content},'%') AND m.plot_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{plotName},'%')
GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.send_time DESC,m.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.send_time >= CURDATE() AND m.send_time < CURDATE()+INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN m.id END) todayCount, COALESCE(SUM(n.is_read=0),0) unreadDeliveryCount,COALESCE(SUM(n.is_read=1),0) readDeliveryCount
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read=1,read_time=COALESCE(read_time,NOW()) WHERE notice_type=3 AND ref_type='maintenance_message' AND ref_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=1
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id,d.name,d.user_id,d.plot_id,p.plot_name FROM iot_device d JOIN plot p ON p.id=d.plot_id
AND (d.user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM farm_owner_technician b WHERE b.owner_user_id=d.user_id AND b.technician_user_id=#{userId} AND b.status=1))
AND d.id=#{id} AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.plot_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 50 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_message(device_id,device_name,owner_id,plot_id,plot_name,title,content,level,publisher_id,publisher_name,content_customized) SELECT d.id,d.name,d.user_id,d.plot_id,p.plot_name,#{title}, #{content},#{level},#{publisherId},#{publisherName},1 FROM iot_device d JOIN plot p ON p.id=d.plot_id WHERE d.id=#{deviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM maintenance_message WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE notification n JOIN maintenance_message m ON n.ref_id=m.id SET n.title=m.title,n.content=m.content,n.level=m.level WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.status=1 AND n.ref_type='maintenance_message' AND n.notice_type=3 AND n.status=1
UPDATE maintenance_message SET status=0,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1
UPDATE notification SET status=0 WHERE ref_type='maintenance_message' AND notice_type=3 AND ref_id=#{id} AND status=1
